release_name: Configurable Network Access and Installation Readiness
highlights: Settings > Network saves the listening IP and port for both launchers
Shared LAN authentication checks, active/pending listener display and recovery overrides
Automatic health checks plus explicit operator verifications replace the capped readiness score
Full duplicate counts, correct health fields, path mapping and failed-scan reporting

validation.browser: Isolated authenticated installation: unavailable address rejected; saved LAN IP/port remains pending until restart; Waitress activates the saved address; readiness records reach 100%, clearing a check produces 91% in both Launchpad and Setup Assistant; no console errors
validation.live_downloads: Not performed; no production integration or media actions
validation.windows_executable: No v18.11.0 executable or installer build claimed

activation: Update source on the installed server, restart locally, configure Network and restart again. Production activation must be verified separately.
